application.name: isisworkspace
application.brief: Modern integrated ISIS workspace with dockable panels

description.p: ISIS Workspace is a modern, integrated application that combines the functionality of multiple ISIS GUI tools into a single unified interface. It features dockable panels for cube viewing, control network editing, and footprint visualization.

ul.li: Dockable panels that can be arranged according to your workflow
Cube viewer with all standard ISIS analysis tools (from qview)
Control network editor for creating and editing control points
Footprint visualization showing image coverage and overlaps
Synchronized views - all panels work with the same cubes
Modern Qt6 interface with dark/light theme support

description.p: The cube viewer panel provides full qview functionality including:
The control network panel allows you to:

ul.li: View control points and measures in table format
2D geographic footprints of all loaded cubes

description.p: Launch ISIS Workspace from the command line with optional cube files:

Once running, use the File menu to open cubes or projects. The View menu allows you to show/hide panels and toggle between dark and light themes. All panel layouts are automatically saved and restored when you reopen the application.
